title: Tangent Plane to an Elliptic Paraboloid
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the equation of the tangent plane to the surface z = 2x^2 + y^2 at the point (1, 1, 3).

steps.title: Compute Partial Derivatives at (1, 1)
steps.explanation: Differentiate z with respect to x and y and evaluate at (1, 1).

steps.title: Apply Tangent Plane Equation
steps.explanation: Substitute coordinates and partial derivatives into point-slope plane formula.
